title: Disconnect
bodyHtml:
Hey human. I’ve seen you with that glowing rectangle,
pawing at it like it’s a toy mouse.
But instead of filling you up, it just drains you, doesn’t it?

Here’s a softer idea: curl up on the sofa with a book.
Add a warm blanket. Maybe a cup of tea.
Let your brain slow down, one page at a time.

Books invite you in. Phones pull you around.
One gives you peace, the other steals it.

So tonight, instead of scrolling until your eyes ache,
join me in a quiet corner. Turn a page. Sip. Breathe. Purr.
